- Two shorter sessions is a very reasonable fallback: (1) exec overview aligned to US morning / EU afternoon, and (2) APAC-friendly technical deep-dive later the same day.

- Option A: Thu Mar 26, 2026 08:30 PT / 17:30 CET / Fri Mar 27 01:30 JST (long for APAC)
- Option B: Fri Mar 27, 2026 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET / Sat Mar 28 02:00 JST (less ideal for APAC)

- APAC deep-dive: Thu Mar 26 23:00 PT / Fri Mar 27 08:00 CET / Sat Mar 28 16:00 JST (60 min)

I'm attaching a draft agenda and the demo deck — if you prefer, I can send a sample updated invite (ICS) once you confirm which approach you want.

Thanks — looping in Jonas for any exec-level conflicts.

Cheers,
